items.summary: In src/render/index.ts, removed the barrel re-exports that nothing imports: frameWidthFor, CameraRig, CarObject, DustPool, LIGHT_DIRECTION, TOON_STEPS and Materials, plus the whole outline.ts line (attachOutline, groundMesh, outlinedFlatMesh, solidMesh, RenderRole). Every name that tests, gates or harness use is still exported, including countdownOffsetEast. Changed the header comment so it says the extra exports are for tests and gates (it previously also said future features).
Removed the `export` keyword from smoothNormals (geometry.ts), CREASE_ANGLE_DEG and attachOutline (outline.ts), and OUTLINE_PX_AT_844 and MaterialKind (materials/index.ts). Nothing else changed.

In src/sim/car.ts, groundUnderBody now fills module scratch arrays bodyTs/bodyHs, declared next to `ground` (cleared with length = 0, filled in the same push order). The heights are filled by a plain indexed loop that calls the same groundAt, so there is no ts.map array or closure. visualPose writes into a scratch `pose` object, and carView copies it into its return value straight away. The floats are computed in the same order and the y >= car.y fallback is the same. Net src/ growth from this item is about +12 lines, which the spec allows for a performance item. Scene hashes (P2) are identical before and after, and all 716 tests pass.
Changed the scene-graph comment in src/render/scene.ts to say 'body mesh, roof roundel + player ▼ marker'.
Changed the GRID_CURVED_FROM comment in src/sim/world.ts to '(races of five or more cars reach them)'.
Changed the comment in tick() in src/game.ts from 'the panel takes over the controls' to 'the results screen takes over the controls'.
